premises.text: Loyal creators are demonetized under opaque rules and lack anyone to talk to on incumbent platforms
premises.evidence_span: you also don't feel like you've got anyone to talk to

premises.text: Viewers get irrelevant ads and abusive comments instead of a safe way to support creators
premises.evidence_span: the comment section is filled with what seems to just be abuse hurled at your favorite creator

premises.text: Watch is a creator-first, safety-first, social-first video-sharing platform
premises.evidence_span: Our values are creator-first, safety-first, and social-first

premises.text: Scalable Kubernetes infrastructure and a million-upload processing pipeline support growth and attacks
premises.evidence_span: built our entire back end upon a system called Kubernetes, which allows us to scale down to really, really low amounts of costs

premises.text: Moderation, Watchdog human endorsement, and an interestingness algorithm keep content safe and relevant
premises.evidence_span: moderation piece, which protects users from things like inappropriate content and also areas like copyrights

premises.text: Creator Hub shows who the audience is and actionable guidance rather than only graphs
premises.evidence_span: you'll see exactly who makes up your audience and actionable queries and statements that will help you to be a better creator

premises.text: Money comes from Super sub micro-subscriptions and advertising that creators control
premises.evidence_span: Super sub, which is a creator-driven micro subscription model, and advertising, a more traditional method that the creator controls

premises.text: Emerging-market strategy locks exclusive content from highly followed regional creators
premises.evidence_span: they have signed an agreement with us to say they're posting exclusive content

value.text: Reward and empower creators while giving consumers a more social, safe video experience
value.evidence_span: rewarding and empowering creators while creating a more social, safe experience for the consumer

causal_links.evidence_span: treated in a way that doesn't seem fair
more social, safe experience for the consumer
